text:
Anton Lundell has two Stanley Cup rings at 25 and is having the best stretch of his season. He has 7 goals and 11 points in 21 games, including a hat trick against Winnipeg on Oct. 30 and two more in a comeback win over Detroit on Nov. 12.

The hot streak is real. He has 8 points (6 goals) in his last ten games, where we'd expect about 6.1 at his ice time, and his own chances are up with them: 3.8 expected goals on his shots in that span against a usual 2.8. Expected goals measure the quality of a player's looks. Across the season his 7 goals sit right on 6.68 expected, so this is not a shooting fluke.

Florida has taken 56.8% of 5-on-5 expected goals with him on the ice, and the team has actually scored 5.7 fewer goals than its chances deserve while he plays, so if anything his assists are lagging. Evolving-Hockey noted last season that he draws the other team's best, 90th percentile competition. That matchup role and the scoring together are what we'd keep watching.
headline: Lundell is hot, and he has earned it
